description: This file defines the JsChart class, which extends SugarChart and provides methods for rendering, generating JSON configurations, and managing charts (including pie, gauge, bar, and funnel charts) within the SuiteCRM environment. It includes chart data processing, XML parsing, and HTML generation for chart legends.

classes.name: JsChart
classes.description: A class for creating and rendering various types of client-side charts, supporting JSON configuration generation, XML processing, and HTML legend rendering within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the JsChart object and calls parent constructor.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given chart type is supported by this chart class.

methods.name: tab
methods.description: Returns a string with a specified number of tabs for indentation purposes.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates and assigns data for rendering a specific chart based on provided XML file.

methods.name: getDashletScript
methods.description: Prepares and assigns chart configuration for dashlet display.

methods.name: chartArray
methods.description: Creates an array of chart configurations from an input array of chart data.

methods.name: getChartConfigParams
methods.description: Extracts chart configuration parameters based on chart type from the XML string.

methods.name: getChartDimensions
methods.description: Determines chart dimensions based on XML data nodes and chart type.

methods.name: checkData
methods.description: Checks if the XML data contains group nodes, indicating data presence.

methods.name: getNumNodes
methods.description: Counts the number of group nodes in the XML data.

methods.name: buildProperties
methods.description: Builds JSON properties section from XML data.

methods.name: buildLabelsBarChartStacked
methods.description: Builds JSON labels for stacked bar charts.

methods.name: buildLabelsBarChart
methods.description: Builds JSON labels for bar charts, handling stacked cases.

methods.name: buildDataBarChartStacked
methods.description: Builds JSON data array for stacked bar charts.

methods.name: buildDataBarChartGrouped
methods.description: Builds JSON data array for grouped bar charts.

methods.name: buildDataBarChart
methods.description: Builds JSON data array for standard bar charts.

methods.name: buildDataPieChart
methods.description: Builds JSON data array for pie charts.

methods.name: buildLabelsPieChart
methods.description: Builds JSON labels for pie charts.

methods.name: buildDataGaugeChart
methods.description: Builds JSON data array for gauge charts.

methods.name: buildLabelsGaugeChart
methods.description: Builds JSON labels for gauge charts.

methods.name: buildJson
methods.description: Compiles complete JSON configuration for a chart based on XML and chart type.

methods.name: saveJsonFile
methods.description: Saves JSON configuration data to a file.

methods.name: get_image_cache_file_name
methods.description: Returns filename for cached chart images.

methods.name: getXMLChartProperties
methods.description: Extracts chart properties from XML string.

methods.name: processSpecialChars
methods.description: Escapes special characters in strings for XML/HTML.

methods.name: processXML
methods.description: Loads XML content from a file and applies charset translation and URL encoding to links.
